abstention.why: orchestrate.route asks the model for a WHOLE envelope as free text; no shipped plugin reports a confidence for that -- not even openai_compatible, whose endpoint can return logprobs, because route calls _ask and _ask discards them. So the rule is not applied on this path at all. What does apply is check_proposal: an area nobody serves, a question type no provider declares, a governed value the engine does not have or a column the data lacks is refused by name and does not run, and how often the router is right is published as route.reliability
